Multiple Wildfires Burn Across US, Destroying Homes and Threatening Communities

Multiple wildfires are actively burning across the United States, prompting significant firefighting efforts and causing property damage. In California, the Palos Fire destroyed two homes near Los Angeles. Meanwhile, in Texas, crews are battling a large grass fire in Parker County that threatens homes and vehicles. Further north, containment efforts are underway for the Lucas Fire near California's Mendocino National Forest. The specific causes and full extent of damage for each fire are still being assessed.
